expected.name: Teruo Konishi
expected.description: Teruo Konishi was a Honolulu teacher at Hawaii Chuo Gakuin Japanese Language School, among its teachers incarcerated during World War II. JCCH records arrest in August 1942, Sand Island confinement September 1942-March 1943, Topaz confinement March-September 1943 and Tule Lake confinement September 1943-March 1946. Its itinerary also lists Crystal City, without dates, and his return to Hawaii in May 1946. This was US wartime civilian incarceration; no individual criminal conviction is established by the cited record. Source: https://incarceration.jcchawaii.org/internees/konishi-teruo

operations.research_note: Primary Tule Lake stockade roster records Konishi, Teruo, born Hawaii March17,1916. Honolulu Star-Bulletin October4,1996 obituary in BYU Hawaii archive records death October1,1996, age80; identity matches Honolulu and Chuo Gakuen Japanese-language teaching documented by JCCH. Refined existing1916 birth year and filled death date. Indexed Crystal City March25,1946 release list remains unresolved until full document context obtained; no custody endpoint inferred.
